* {{AoC}} }} }} ==Location and Uses== It is the traditional Shield bore by the [[Knights of Hyrule]] and is commonly used by [[Link]] in 3D ''Zelda'' games alongside the [[Master Sword]].{{Cite|This is a big, heavy Shield just like the ones Hylian Knights use. It can stand up to flame attacks!|Bazaar Owner|OoT}} Unlike [[Wooden Shield]]s, the Hylian Shield will not burn upon contact with fire.{{Cite|Hylian Shield A shield with a Hylian crest. Defend against attacks with Z. It's metal and will never burn.|N/A|TP}}{{Cite|You got the Hylian shield! Press Z to defend yourself. It's metal and will never burn.|N/A|TP}} Though it is made of steel, it is light and sturdy, an optimal weight for a fighter with a one-handed weapon.{{Cite Book|quote= Though it is made of steel, it is light and sturdy, an optimal weight for a fighter with a one-handed weapon.|book= E |page= 84}} Throughout the ''Zelda'' games, the Hylian Shield has changed little in terms of overall appearance, always bearing the symbol of the [[Triforce]] and, beneath it, a red [[Hylian Crest]] representing the goddess [[Hylia]] and the [[Crimson Loftwing]] that helped Link at the founding of [[Hyrule]].{{Cite Book|quote= Our hero, who rescues the land that will later become Hyrule, rides a red bird. This is why the mark of a bird appears on his shield. However, since the design had already appeared, was this some herald of fate to come? Loftwings are modeled after birds called shoebills, and the idea for their curled tails came from the designer's pet shiba - Hiraoka, designer |book= HH|publisher= |page= 9}}{{Cite Book|quote=The bird-like design that is painted to look as though it is protecting the Triforce is the mark of the goddess Hylia and also depicts the brilliant red Loftwing once ridden by the hero.|book= E |page=84}} The first Hylian Shield was a legendary Shield guarded by the Thunder Dragon [[Lanayru (Dragon)|Lanayru]], who created the [[Thunder Dragon's Lightning Round|Lightning Round]] to judge whether someone would be worthy of wielding the Shield.{{Cite|Yes, yes... The Thunder Dragon. The goddess gave the Thunder Dragon the power to protect the desert. This dragon possesses a legendary shield. It is truly one of its most prized treasures. It is said that the Thunder Dragon delights in testing those with promise in the hopes of someday finding a worthy recipient for the shield.|Eldin (Dragon)|SS}} ==={{LA|-}}=== {{Main|Shield}} While the Hylian Shield did not appear in the original or DX versions of {{LA}}, the [[Shield]] was given the appearance of the Hylian Shield in {{LANS|-}}. It it received from [[Tarin]] after [[Link]] wakes up on [[Koholint Island]]. ==={{OoT|-}}=== {{Descriptions OoT}} The Hylian Shield can either be purchased or found by [[Link]] as a child in {{OoT}}. Emblazoned with [[Hylian]] artwork, complete with a [[Crimson Loftwing]] and the [[Triforce]], the Hylian Shield is much too large for young Link to wield on his arm and functions more like a turtle's shell.{{Cite|My current hot seller is the Hylian Shield, but it might be too big for you, kid.|Bazaar Owner|OoT}} After his seven year sleep, Link became able to use it as his standard [[Shield]]. The Hylian Shield becomes almost necessary to survive a visit to the [[Great Fairy]] in [[Death Mountain]], as child Link's 'turtle shell' use of the Shield protects from recurrent flaming rock eruptions. It is also not prone to the risk of being burnt by particular fire-borne enemies, such as the [[Fire Keese]].{{Cite|Fire Keese Destroy it before it flies into you! If you don't, its flames will burn up your Deku Shield!|Navi|OoT}} However, the Hylian Shield can be consumed by the Shield-eating [[Like Likes]] if Link is swallowed by one.{{Cite|Like Like
An enemy that eats shields and certain clothes. Beat it quickly to get your gear back!|Navi|OoT}} Child Link's use of the Shield limits mobility while defending and does not provide as much adequate protection from the front as the Deku Shield (and the Hylian Shield as an adult) and is similarly unable to reflect [[Deku Scrub]] and [[Octorok]] attacks, but it can defend Link from the [[Boulder]]s that rain from [[Death Mountain]]. The guard at the gates of [[Kakariko Village]] (leading to [[Death Mountain]]) can offer Link a discount in correspondence with the owner of the Bazaar in [[Hyrule Castle Town]].{{Cite|By the way, Mr. Hero... If you're going to climb Death Mountain, you should equip a proper shield! It is an active volcano, after all! If you go back to Hyrule Castle Town Market, you should check out the Bazaar. They sell the shield you need there. Tell 'em I sent you and they should give you a special discount!|Guard|OoT}} If Link speaks to the guard and then attempts to purchase the Hylian Shield at normal price at the Bazaar in the [[Market]], the shop owner will give Link a discount of random values in intervals of 5 Rupees between a total price of 45 to 75 Rupees.{{Cite|You heard about us from the guard at Death Mountain gate? Well, I have to give you a good deal then!|Bazaar Owner|OoT}} However, the Shield cannot be bought even with the discount if Link does not have 80 Rupees. Despite the discount, a free Hylian Shield can be found if Link opens a certain grave at night in the [[Kakariko Village Graveyard]]. ==={{TP|-}}=== In {{TP}}, the Hylian Shield becomes available before entering the [[Goron Mines]] in the newly established [[Malo Mart]] in [[Kakariko Village]] for 200 [[Rupee]]s.{{Cite|Hylian Shield: 200 Rupees LIMITED SUPPLY! Don't let them sell out before you buy one!|Malo|TP}} It can also be bought (for a slightly higher price of 210 Rupees) from a [[Goron]] in [[Hyrule Castle Town]].{{Cite|I cannot sell it for as low a price as you might get in Kakariko Village, but for you, I can still make a decent bargain, Brother. Would you want a Hylian shield for 210 Rupees?|Goron|TP}} Unlike the [[Wooden Shield]] and [[Ordon Shield]], the Hylian Shield is indestructible as it is made of metal. However, it is unable to catch [[Arrow]]s that strike it, merely deflecting them instead. Its appearance is largely similar to its {{OoT}} appearance, with some minor design changes. Unlike {{OoT|-}}, the metal frame is thinner and the numerous rivets are replaced by three large bolts. The [[Triforce]] symbol has become smaller, now with metal framing it. In contrast, the [[Wingcrest|Royal Crest]] is noticeably bigger and takes up the entire bottom half of the Hylian Shield. The inverted triangle at the bottom has been removed and two metal decals take its place. ==={{SS|-}}=== As with all other Shields in {{SS}}, the Hylian Shield is controlled by using the Nunchuk: by quickly thrusting the Nunchuk forward, Link will raise his Shield and use it to defend himself against enemy attacks. Unlike other Shields in the game, this Hylian Shield is imbued with heroic power, making it indestructible, with its durability bar permanently filled with a glowing blue color to signify this. Unlike its past appearances, the Hylian Shield cannot be obtained early on in the game, due to the nature of normal Shields as potentially temporary items with limited durability. It is the reward from the Thunder Dragon [[Lanayru (Dragon)|Lanayru]]'s [[Thunder Dragon's Lightning Round|Lightning Round]] if Link wins eight fights consecutively and then quits. The Hylian Shield's design originally was largely similar to that of {{TP|-}}, albeit with brighter colors more akin to the original {{OoT|-}} design. Sometime prior to E3 2011, the design was altered, removing the silver rim around the Triforce and the metal ornamentation beneath the Crimson Loftwing design. ==={{ALBW|-}}=== The Hylian Shield is found in [[Turtle Rock]] in {{ALBW}}, by killing all four [[Fire Wizzrobe]] on the first floor. When obtained, it replaces the standard Shield once obtained. Unlike the standard Shield, it can block magical attacks such as the beams fired by [[Beamos]], as well as block the [[Lynel]]s' fire breath,{{Cite|You got the Hylian Shield! This can protect you against magical attacks.|N/A|ALBW}} although it cannot reflect them back. Although the Shield is referred to as a Hylian Shield and bears the Hyrulean Triforce, it is not known or explained how it came to be housed in a [[Lorule]]an dungeon. ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |defense = 90 |durability = 800 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Hylian Shield}} The Hylian Shield is located in a [[Treasure Chest]] in the [[Lockup Back Room]] within [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]], guarded by a [[Stalnox]].{{Cite|- Test of the Royal Guard -
Strike down the giant foe to become recognized as a knight of the kingdom.|Stone Tablet|BotW}} It is said to have been passed down through the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]] along with legends of the hero. The defensive capability and [[Durability]] of this [[Shield]] are known to outshine all others. It is the strongest and most durable Shield in the game, having a Durability of 800 (up to 1160 with Durability Up +) and Defense rating of 90 (up to 144 with Guard Up +). Unlike {{SS|-}}, the Hylian Shield is capable of breaking like other Shields. Once obtained within Hyrule Castle, it can be purchased from [[Granté]] in [[Tarrey Town]] for 3,000 [[Rupee]]s, provided [[Link]] does not have one already. However, when purchased here, it does not come with a chance of being granted modifiers. When spoken to at [[Trilby Plain]], [[Russ]] of the [[Shield Breakers]] will explain that all [[Shield Surfing|Shield Surfers]] have heard of and covet the Hylian Shield.{{Cite|Oh! Speaking of not breaking, have ya heard about the {{Color BotW|Blue|Hylian shield}}? Everyone in the surfing scene covets that bad boy.|Russ|BotW}} He believes it to have been commissioned by the Royal Family, and its Durability makes it perfect for Shield Surfing.{{Cite|It's clearly commissioned by the royal family or somethin'! It's sturdiness makes it perfect for shield surfing too.|Russ|BotW}} The traveler [[Baumar]] has also heard about the Hylian Shield's durability.{{Cite|Apparently, there's a totally durable shield called a {{Color BotW|Red|Hylian shield}} somewhere in {{Color BotW|Blue|Hyrule Castle}}. Sounds gnarly, dude!|Baumar|BotW}} The Hylian Shield, being made of metal, will attract [[Lightning]] if it is equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]] and conduct [[Electricity]]. It will also sink if it is dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but it can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Finally, it will not burn if it is exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_030" |Life = 800 |GuardPower = 90 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 104 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 216 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 14 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 32 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 217 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 360 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 33 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 54 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Hylian Shield}} {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 90 |durability = 800 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} {{Stub|TotK}} The Hylian Shield is located in a [[Treasure Chest]] in the [[Docks]] of [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]], where the [[Saas Ko'sah Shrine]] was located in {{BotW}}. This chest will appear once the nearby torch was lit, similar to said shrine in the previous game. As per before, it is the most durable shield in the game, with a [[Durability]] of 800 (up to 810 with Durability Up +), and a Defense rating of 90 (up to 100 with Guard Up +). If it is broken, a replacement can be bought from [[Cece]] in [[Hateno Village]], assuming Link does not already have one in his inventory and "[[The Mayoral Election]]" [[Side Adventure]] has been completed. ==={{EoW|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= EoW |type= Items |category= Items in Echoes of Wisdom |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Who uses Hylian Shields * Characteristics of the Hylian Shield }} {{Descriptions EoW}} {{Stub|EoW}} [[Link]] uses a Hylian Shield while rescuing [[Zelda]] from [[Ganon]] at the beginning of the story. When [[Zelda]] activates her [[Swordfighter Form]], she carries a semblance of a Hylian Shield which can protect her from enemy attacks. ==Other Appearances== ==={{SSB|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{smashwiki|Shield (Link)|Link's Shields}} In {{SSB}}, [[Link]] wields the Hylian Shield alongside the [[Master Sword]]. The Shield is based on its {{OoT|-}} iteration but it offers no protection. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{SSBM|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} In {{SSBM}}, Link once again wields the Hylian Shield and it is based on its {{OoT|-}} iteration. When Link is not moving, it is possible for him to block some projectiles with his Shield and get pushed back instead of taking damage. Whether the projectile is blocked or not depends on how much damage or knockback the projectile would normally do. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{SCII|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} In {{SCII}}, the Hylian Shield also appears as Link's default weapon, along with the Master Sword. It is his most balanced weapon in the game.{{Cite|A magic sword and shield that have accompanied Link on many adventures and helped him repeatedly save the land of Hyrule. This journey is no less dire, and Link once again goes into battle equipped with these items, this time in another world. These are well-balanced arms for Link.|N/A|SCII}} The Hylian Shield is also paired off with other weapons such as the [[Biggoron's Sword]], [[Razor Sword]], the [[Great Fairy Sword]], and the [[Bug-Catching Net]]. {{Data Table |game= SCII |collapse= true |columns= Item [Image:Model:100px][Link], Cost [Nowrap], Attributes [Nowrap][List], Description [Description] |- | Master Sword | Free | Well-balanced | A magic sword and shield that have accompanied Link on many adventures and helped him repeatedly save the land of Hyrule. This journey is no less dire, and Link once again goes into battle equipped with these items, this time in another world. These are well-balanced arms for Link. |- | Razor Sword | 600 Gold | Attack goes up 25%, Short reach, Takes 15% block damage | A sword forged by the [[Gabora|blacksmith]] from the [[Mountain Village]] on [[Snowhead]]. The blacksmith is famous for his perfectionism--this sword is yet another excellent example of of his craftsmanship and boasts an amazingly sharp cutting edge. Unfortunately, the metal used to forge this blade is prone to chipping, so there remains some concern about its defensive capabilities. |- | Megaton Hammer | 1200 Gold | Offense goes up 35%, Short reach | An extremely heavy hammer. Learning to use it effectively could take some time, as its reach is somewhat short for a weapon. Its power and toughness, however, far exceed that of any normal sword. It's guaranteed to inspire awe. |- | Cane of Byrna | 1600 Gold | Soul Charge boosts offense up to 50%{{Exp|continuous effect}}, Soul Charge lowers damage received by 25%{{Exp|diminishing effect}}, Soul Charge recovers up to 32 HP each time | An ancient magic staff that grants protection to heroes. It can be used even by those who are not sorcerers as long as their hearts are pure. It is said that praying to the staff with all one's heart will shroud the user in light and fill him with vitality. Because it is not a true weapon, it usually does not fare well when it clashes against an opponent's weapon. |- | Biggoron Sword | 4000 Gold | Long reach, Drains 3 HP per attack | A masterfully crafted long sword forged by the best blacksmith in [[Hyrule]], [[Biggoron]], who lives on [[Death Mountain]]. Designed specifically for Link, it is made to be wielded with one hand. Even so, swinging it with full force gets tiring after a while. |- | Great Fairy's Sword | 9800 Gold | Attack goes up 20%, Gains 5 HP per second, Takes 20% block damage | A sword blessed by the [[Great Fairy]], rumored to be able to reflect any and all dark magic. Merely holding it fills the wielder with strength, but unfortunately, its protective power did not survive intact in this world, and it is no longer able to resist enemy attacks. |- | Bug-Catching Net | 12,500 Gold | Offense decreases 80%, Defenses decreases 80% | A long-handled net used for catching bugs. This item is an old companion of Link's and has appeared on many of his adventures--it accompanies him on this adventure as well. Obviously, it is not a weapon, but perhaps it will cause opponents to let down their guard. }} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{SSBB|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} In {{SSBB}}, the Hylian Shield is wielded by Link and is based on its {{TP|-}} iteration. Like in {{SSBM|-}}, it can block some projectiles when Link is not moving. The Hylian Shield also appears as two [[Sticker]]s, one based on its {{TMC|-}} iteration and the other based on its {{TP|-}} iteration. {{SSBSticker|header=yes}} {{#section:Sticker|Hylian Shield}} |} {{Noncanon|End}} ===''Zelda HD Experience''=== {{Noncanon|Start}} [[Link]] wields the Hylian Shield along with the [[Ordon Sword]] in a battle against [[Armogohma]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{NL|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} In {{NL|-}}, the first player wields a bow (or optionally a sword and shield if playing singleplayer) and the other one to four players wield swords and shields. The swords resemble the Master Sword, while the shields resemble the Hylian Shield. However, the shields' (and swords') base color changes to match the color of the player wielding them (with the exception of the first player in singleplayer, where the sword and shield will be colored blue, despite the first player being green). The shield's design is much more simplistic than the majority of its canon appearances, and is flat across the top and lacks the curved edges on the bottom as well as the metal designs above the Triforce crest. The back of the shield is made of wood, similar to its in-game appearance in Ocarina of Time. Similar to its functionality in Skyward Sword, the shield is controlled using the Nunchuck and can block melee attacks as well as projectiles. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{HW|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Main|Master Sword}} In {{HW}}, the Hylian Shield appears paired with the Master Sword. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{MNPTP|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} [[File:MNPTP Hylian Shield Sprite.png|left|50px]] The fifth puzzle in the ''Picross'' series and the fifteenth puzzle in the ''Mega Picross'' series depict a Hylian Shield. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{SSB4|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} In {{SSB4}}, Link wields the Hylian Shield, which is still based on its {{TP|-}} iteration. The Shield can block some projectiles if Link is not moving or while Link is walking. When the Shield blocks a projectile, Link will take a defensive stance. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{SSBU|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Link once again wields the Hylian Shield in {{SSBU}}. The Shield is based on its {{BotW|-}} iteration. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Hylian Shield can be wielded by Link in conjunction with the Master Sword. It is based on its appearance from {{BotW|-}}. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== *While parts of the back of the Hylian Shield are made with wood, most of the artwork for {{OoT|-}} depicts the Shield made entirely of metal. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:OoT Hylian Shield Low-Poly Model.png|{{Game Label|{{OoT|-}}}}The Hylian Shield as seen when obtained File:Hylian Shield OO Beta1.png|{{Game Label|{{OoT|-}}}}The first early version of the Hylian Shield File:Hylian Shield OO Beta2.png|{{Game Label|{{OoT|-}}}}The second early version of the Hylian Shield File:TP Hylian Shield Concept.jpg|{{Game Label|{{TP|-}}}}Concept art of the Hylian Shield File:TPHD Hylian Shield Artwork 2.png|{{Game Label|{{TPHD|-}}}}Alternate artwork of the Hylian Shield File:SS Hylian Shield and Master Sword Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{SS|-}}}}Artwork of the Master Sword and the Hylian Shield File:SS Hylian Shield Concept Model.png|{{Game Label|{{SS|-}}}}Early version of Hylian Shield File:SSHD Twitter Hylian Shield Emoji.png|{{Game Label|{{SSHD|-}}}}A promotional Hylian Shield emoji for the release File:NL Hylian Shield Render.png|{{Game Label|{{NL|-}}}}The Hylian Shield File:HW Hylian Shield Model.png|{{Game Label|{{HW|-}}}}The Hylian Shield ==See Also== {{See Also| * Holy Hylian Shield * Master Sword }} {{Ref| {{Cite Book|quote= |book= E |publisher= |page= 127}} {{Cite|{{Big|Hylian Shield}}
